<dd><p>Bases: <a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#object" title="(in Python v3.14)"><code class="xref py py-class docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">object</span></code></a></p>
<p>Main SSMD document container with incremental building and editing.</p>
<p>This is the primary interface for working with SSMD documents. It provides
a clean, document-centric API for creating, editing, and exporting TTS content.</p>
<p>The Document stores content as fragments (pieces of text) with separators
between them, allowing efficient incremental building and editing while
preserving the document structure.</p>
<dl>
<dt>Example:</dt><dd><p>Basic usage:</p>
<div class="highlight-default notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">ssmd</span>

<span class="c1"># Create and build a document</span>
<span class="n">doc</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ssmd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Document</span><span class="p">()</span>
<span class="n">doc</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">add_sentence</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;Hello world!&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">doc</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">add_sentence</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;This is SSMD.&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># Export to different formats</span>
<span class="n">ssml</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">doc</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">to_ssml</span><span class="p">()</span>
<span class="n">text</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">doc</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">to_text</span><span class="p">()</span>

<span class="c1"># Iterate for streaming TTS</span>
<span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">sentence</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">doc</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">sentences</span><span class="p">():</span>
    <span class="n">tts_engine</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">speak</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">sentence</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Advanced usage:</p>
<div class="highlight-default notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="c1"># Load from SSML</span>
<span class="n">doc</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ssmd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Document</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">from_ssml</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;&lt;speak&gt;Hello&lt;/speak&gt;&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># Edit the document</span>
<span class="n">doc</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">&quot;Modified content&quot;</span>
<span class="n">doc</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">add_paragraph</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;New paragraph&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># Access raw content</span>
<span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">doc</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">ssmd</span><span class="p">)</span>  <span class="c1"># Raw SSMD markdown</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</dd>
</dl>

class="pre">None</span></a></span></span><a class="reference internal" href="../_modules/ssmd/document/#Document.__init__"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>
<dd><p>Initialize a new SSMD document.</p>
<dl>
<dt>Args:</dt><dd><p>content: Optional initial SSMD content
config: Configuration dictionary with options:</p>
<blockquote>
<div><ul class="simple">
<li><p>skip (list): Processor names to skip</p></li>
<li><p>output_speak_tag (bool): Wrap in &lt;speak&gt; tags (default: True)</p></li>
<li><p>pretty_print (bool): Format XML output (default: False)</p></li>
<li><p>auto_sentence_tags (bool): Auto-wrap sentences (default: False)</p></li>
<li><p>heading_levels (dict): Custom heading configurations</p></li>
<li><p>extensions (dict): Registered extension handlers</p></li>
<li><p>namespaces (dict): XML namespaces to add to the &lt;speak&gt; tag</p></li>
<li><p>sentence_model_size (str): spaCy model size for sentence
detection (“sm”, “md”, “lg”, “trf”). Default: “sm”</p></li>
<li><p>sentence_spacy_model (str): Deprecated alias; model size is
inferred from the name (overrides sentence_model_size)</p></li>
<li><p>sentence_use_spacy (bool): If False, use fast regex splitting
instead of spaCy. Default: True</p></li>
</ul>
</div></blockquote>
<dl class="simple">
<dt>capabilities: TTS capabilities (TTSCapabilities instance or</dt><dd><p>preset name). Presets: ‘espeak’, ‘pyttsx3’, ‘google’,
‘polly’, ‘azure’, ‘minimal’, ‘full’</p>
</dd>
<dt>escape_syntax: If True, escape SSMD-like syntax in content to</dt><dd><p>prevent interpretation as markup. Useful for plain text or
markdown that may coincidentally contain SSMD patterns.</p>
</dd>
<dt>escape_patterns: List of specific pattern types to escape when</dt><dd><p>escape_syntax=True. If None, escapes all patterns.
Valid values: ‘emphasis’, ‘annotations’, ‘breaks’, ‘marks’,
‘headings’, ‘directives’</p>
</dd>
<dt>parse_yaml_header: If True, parse YAML front matter and store it</dt><dd><p>on doc.header while stripping it from the SSMD body. If False,
YAML front matter is preserved as part of the content.</p>
</dd>
<dt>strict: If True, emit warnings and apply ssml-green validation</dt><dd><p>rules where possible.</p>
</dd>
</dl>
</dd>
<dt>Example:</dt><dd><div class="doctest highlight-default notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ssmd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Document</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;Hello *world*!&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ssmd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Document</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">capabilities</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s1">&#39;pyttsx3&#39;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ssmd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Document</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;Text&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">config</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="s1">&#39;auto_sentence_tags&#39;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">})</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="c1"># Fast sentence detection (no spaCy required)</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ssmd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Document</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">config</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="s1">&#39;sentence_use_spacy&#39;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="kc">False</span><span class="p">})</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="c1"># High quality sentence detection</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ssmd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Document</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">config</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="s1">&#39;sentence_model_size&#39;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s1">&#39;lg&#39;</span><span class="p">})</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="c1"># Escape SSMD syntax for plain text/markdown</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ssmd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Document</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">markdown</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">escape_syntax</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="c1"># Selective escaping</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ssmd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Document</span><span class="p">(</span>
<span class="gp">... </span>    <span class="n">text</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="gp">... </span>    <span class="n">escape_syntax</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="gp">... </span>    <span class="n">escape_patterns</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">&#39;emphasis&#39;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">&#39;annotations&#39;</span><span class="p">]</span>
<span class="gp">... </span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</dd>
</dl>
</dd></dl>

</pre></div>

<p><strong>Building Methods:</strong></p>
<dl class="py method">
<dt class="sig sig-object py" id="ssmd.Document.add">
<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">add</span></span><span class="sig-paren">(</span><em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">text</span></span><span class="p"><span class="pre">:</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n"><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">str</span></a></span></em><span class="sig-paren">)</span> <span class="sig-return"><span class="sig-return-icon">&#x2192;</span> <span class="sig-return-typehint"><a class="reference internal" href="#ssmd.document.Document" title="ssmd.document.Document"><span class="pre">Document</span></a></span></span><a class="reference internal" href="../_modules/ssmd/document/#Document.add"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>
<dd><p>Append text without separator.</p>
<p>Use this when you want to append content immediately after
the previous content with no spacing.</p>
<dl>
<dt>Args:</dt><dd><p>text: SSMD text to append</p>
</dd>
<dt>Returns:</dt><dd><p>Self for method chaining</p>
</dd>
<dt>Example:</dt><dd><div class="doctest highlight-default notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ssmd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Document</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;Hello&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">add</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot; world&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">ssmd</span>
<span class="go">&#39;Hello world&#39;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</dd>
</dl>
</dd></dl>

<dl class="py method">
<dt class="sig sig-object py" id="ssmd.Document.add_sentence">
<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">add_sentence</span></span><span class="sig-paren">(</span><em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">text</span></span><span class="p"><span class="pre">:</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n"><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">str</span></a></span></em><span class="sig-paren">)</span> <span class="sig-return"><span class="sig-return-icon">&#x2192;</span> <span class="sig-return-typehint"><a class="reference internal" href="#ssmd.document.Document" title="ssmd.document.Document"><span class="pre">Document</span></a></span></span><a class="reference internal" href="../_modules/ssmd/document/#Document.add_sentence"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>
<dd><p>Append text with newline separator.</p>
<p>Use this to add a new sentence on a new line.</p>
<dl>
<dt>Args:</dt><dd><p>text: SSMD text to append</p>
</dd>
<dt>Returns:</dt><dd><p>Self for method chaining</p>
</dd>
<dt>Example:</dt><dd><div class="doctest highlight-default notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ssmd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Document</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;First sentence.&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">add_sentence</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;Second sentence.&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">ssmd</span>
<span class="go">&#39;First sentence.\nSecond sentence.&#39;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</dd>
</dl>
</dd></dl>

<dl class="py method">
<dt class="sig sig-object py" id="ssmd.Document.add_paragraph">
<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">add_paragraph</span></span><span class="sig-paren">(</span><em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">text</span></span><span class="p"><span class="pre">:</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n"><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">str</span></a></span></em><span class="sig-paren">)</span> <span class="sig-return"><span class="sig-return-icon">&#x2192;</span> <span class="sig-return-typehint"><a class="reference internal" href="#ssmd.document.Document" title="ssmd.document.Document"><span class="pre">Document</span></a></span></span><a class="reference internal" href="../_modules/ssmd/document/#Document.add_paragraph"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>
<dd><p>Append text with double newline separator.</p>
<p>Use this to start a new paragraph.</p>
<dl>
<dt>Args:</dt><dd><p>text: SSMD text to append</p>
</dd>
<dt>Returns:</dt><dd><p>Self for method chaining</p>
</dd>
<dt>Example:</dt><dd><div class="doctest highlight-default notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ssmd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Document</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;First paragraph.&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">add_paragraph</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;Second paragraph.&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">ssmd</span>
<span class="go">&#39;First paragraph.\n\nSecond paragraph.&#39;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</dd>
</dl>
</dd></dl>

<p><strong>Export Methods:</strong></p>
<dl class="py method">
<dt class="sig sig-object py" id="ssmd.Document.to_ssml">
<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">to_ssml</span></span><span class="sig-paren">(</span><span class="sig-paren">)</span> <span class="sig-return"><span class="sig-return-icon">&#x2192;</span> <span class="sig-return-typehint"><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">str</span></a></span></span><a class="reference internal" href="../_modules/ssmd/document/#Document.to_ssml"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>
<dd><p>Export document to SSML format.</p>
<dl>
<dt>Returns:</dt><dd><p>SSML XML string</p>
</dd>
<dt>Example:</dt><dd><div class="doctest highlight-default notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ssmd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Document</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;Hello *world*!&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">to_ssml</span><span class="p">()</span>
<span class="go">&#39;&lt;speak&gt;Hello &lt;emphasis&gt;world&lt;/emphasis&gt;!&lt;/speak&gt;&#39;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</dd>
</dl>
</dd></dl>

<dl class="py method">
<dt class="sig sig-object py" id="ssmd.Document.to_ssmd">
<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">to_ssmd</span></span><span class="sig-paren">(</span><span class="sig-paren">)</span> <span class="sig-return"><span class="sig-return-icon">&#x2192;</span> <span class="sig-return-typehint"><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">str</span></a></span></span><a class="reference internal" href="../_modules/ssmd/document/#Document.to_ssmd"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>
<dd><p>Export document to SSMD format with proper formatting.</p>
<p>Returns SSMD with proper line breaks (each sentence on a new line).</p>
<dl>
<dt>Returns:</dt><dd><p>SSMD markdown string with proper formatting</p>
</dd>
<dt>Example:</dt><dd><div class="doctest highlight-default notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ssmd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Document</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">from_ssml</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">&#39;&lt;speak&gt;&lt;emphasis&gt;Hi&lt;/emphasis&gt;&lt;/speak&gt;&#39;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">to_ssmd</span><span class="p">()</span>
<span class="go">&#39;*Hi*&#39;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</dd>
</dl>
</dd></dl>

<dl class="py method">
<dt class="sig sig-object py" id="ssmd.Document.to_text">
<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">to_text</span></span><span class="sig-paren">(</span><span class="sig-paren">)</span> <span class="sig-return"><span class="sig-return-icon">&#x2192;</span> <span class="sig-return-typehint"><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">str</span></a></span></span><a class="reference internal" href="../_modules/ssmd/document/#Document.to_text"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>
<dd><p>Export document to plain text (strips all markup).</p>
<dl>
<dt>Returns:</dt><dd><p>Plain text string with all SSMD markup removed</p>
</dd>
<dt>Example:</dt><dd><div class="doctest highlight-default notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ssmd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Document</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;Hello *world* @marker!&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">to_text</span><span class="p">()</span>
<span class="go">&#39;Hello world!&#39;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</dd>
</dl>
</dd></dl>

<p><strong>Iteration:</strong></p>
<dl class="py method">
<dt class="sig sig-object py" id="ssmd.Document.sentences">
<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">sentences</span></span><span class="sig-paren">(</span><em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">as_documents</span></span><span class="p"><span class="pre">:</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n"><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#bool" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">bool</span></a></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o"><span class="pre">=</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="default_value"><span class="pre">False</span></span></em><span class="sig-paren">)</span> <span class="sig-return"><span class="sig-return-icon">&#x2192;</span> <span class="sig-return-typehint"><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/collections.abc.html#collections.abc.Iterator" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">Iterator</span></a><span class="p"><span class="pre">[</span></span><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">str</span></a><span class="w"> </span><span class="p"><span class="pre">|</span></span><span class="w"> </span><a class="reference internal" href="#ssmd.document.Document" title="ssmd.document.Document"><span class="pre">Document</span></a><span class="p"><span class="pre">]</span></span></span></span><a class="reference internal" href="../_modules/ssmd/document/#Document.sentences"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>
<dd><p>Iterate through sentence-level SSML chunks.</p>
<p>Sentences are always returned as explicit <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">&lt;s&gt;</span></code>-wrapped SSML fragments
so the streaming interface remains stable regardless of paragraph tags.</p>
<dl>
<dt>Args:</dt><dd><dl class="simple">
<dt>as_documents: If True, yield Document objects instead of strings.</dt><dd><p>Each sentence will be wrapped in its own Document instance.</p>
</dd>
</dl>
</dd>
<dt>Yields:</dt><dd><p>SSML sentence strings (str), or Document objects if as_documents=True</p>
</dd>
<dt>Example:</dt><dd><div class="doctest highlight-default notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ssmd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Document</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;First. Second. Third.&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">sentence</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">doc</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">sentences</span><span class="p">():</span>
<span class="gp">... </span>    <span class="n">tts_engine</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">speak</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">sentence</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<div class="doctest highlight-default notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">sentence_doc</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">doc</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">sentences</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">as_documents</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">):</span>
<span class="gp">... </span>    <span class="n">ssml</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">sentence_doc</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">to_ssml</span><span class="p">()</span>
<span class="gp">... </span>    <span class="n">ssmd</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">sentence_doc</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">to_ssmd</span><span class="p">()</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</dd>
</dl>
</dd></dl>

<dl class="py method">
<dt class="sig sig-object py" id="ssmd.Document.__iter__">
<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">__iter__</span></span><span class="sig-paren">(</span><span class="sig-paren">)</span> <span class="sig-return"><span class="sig-return-icon">&#x2192;</span> <span class="sig-return-typehint"><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/collections.abc.html#collections.abc.Iterator" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">Iterator</span></a><span class="p"><span class="pre">[</span></span><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">str</span></a><span class="w"> </span><span class="p"><span class="pre">|</span></span><span class="w"> </span><a class="reference internal" href="#ssmd.document.Document" title="ssmd.document.Document"><span class="pre">Document</span></a><span class="p"><span class="pre">]</span></span></span></span><a class="reference internal" href="../_modules/ssmd/document/#Document.__iter__"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>
<dd><p>Iterate through sentences.</p>
<dl>
<dt>Yields:</dt><dd><p>SSML sentence strings</p>
</dd>
<dt>Example:</dt><dd><div class="doctest highlight-default notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ssmd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Document</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;First. Second.&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">sentence</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">doc</span><span class="p">:</span>
<span class="gp">... </span>    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">sentence</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</dd>
</dl>
</dd></dl>

<dl class="py method">
<dt class="sig sig-object py" id="ssmd.Document.__len__">
<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">__len__</span></span><span class="sig-paren">(</span><span class="sig-paren">)</span> <span class="sig-return"><span class="sig-return-icon">&#x2192;</span> <span class="sig-return-typehint"><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#int" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">int</span></a></span></span><a class="reference internal" href="../_modules/ssmd/document/#Document.__len__"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>
<dd><p>Return number of sentences in the document.</p>
<dl>
<dt>Returns:</dt><dd><p>Number of sentences</p>
</dd>
<dt>Example:</dt><dd><div class="doctest highlight-default notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ssmd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Document</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;First sentence. Second sentence.&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">doc</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="go">2</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</dd>
</dl>
</dd></dl>

<p><strong>List-like Interface:</strong></p>
<dl class="py method">
<dt class="sig sig-object py" id="ssmd.Document.__getitem__">
<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">__getitem__</span></span><span class="sig-paren">(</span><em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">index</span></span><span class="p"><span class="pre">:</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n"><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#int" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">int</span></a></span></em><span class="sig-paren">)</span> <span class="sig-return"><span class="sig-return-icon">&#x2192;</span> <span class="sig-return-typehint"><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">str</span></a></span></span><a class="reference internal" href="../_modules/ssmd/document/#Document.__getitem__"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>
<dt class="sig sig-object py">
<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">__getitem__</span></span><span class="sig-paren">(</span><em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">index</span></span><span class="p"><span class="pre">:</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n"><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#slice" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">slice</span></a></span></em><span class="sig-paren">)</span> <span class="sig-return"><span class="sig-return-icon">&#x2192;</span> <span class="sig-return-typehint"><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#list" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">list</span></a><span class="p"><span class="pre">[</span></span><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">str</span></a><span class="p"><span class="pre">]</span></span></span></span></dt>
<dd><p>Get sentence(s) by index.</p>
<dl>
<dt>Args:</dt><dd><p>index: Sentence index or slice</p>
</dd>
<dt>Returns:</dt><dd><p>SSML sentence string or list of strings</p>
</dd>
<dt>Raises:</dt><dd><p>IndexError: If index is out of range</p>
</dd>
<dt>Example:</dt><dd><div class="doctest highlight-default notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ssmd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Document</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;First. Second. Third.&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span>  <span class="c1"># First sentence SSML</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]</span>  <span class="c1"># Last sentence SSML</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">]</span>  <span class="c1"># First two sentences</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</dd>
</dl>
</dd></dl>

<dl class="py method">
<dt class="sig sig-object py" id="ssmd.Document.__setitem__">
<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">__setitem__</span></span><span class="sig-paren">(</span><em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">index</span></span><span class="p"><span class="pre">:</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n"><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#int" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">int</span></a></span></em>, <em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">value</span></span><span class="p"><span class="pre">:</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n"><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">str</span></a></span></em><span class="sig-paren">)</span> <span class="sig-return"><span class="sig-return-icon">&#x2192;</span> <span class="sig-return-typehint"><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/constants.html#None" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">None</span></a></span></span><a class="reference internal" href="../_modules/ssmd/document/#Document.__setitem__"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>
<dd><p>Replace sentence at index.</p>
<p>This reconstructs the document with the modified sentence.</p>
<dl>
<dt>Args:</dt><dd><p>index: Sentence index
value: New SSMD content for this sentence</p>
</dd>
<dt>Raises:</dt><dd><p>IndexError: If index is out of range</p>
</dd>
<dt>Example:</dt><dd><div class="doctest highlight-default notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ssmd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Document</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;First. Second. Third.&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">&quot;Modified first sentence.&quot;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</dd>
</dl>
</dd></dl>

<dl class="py method">
<dt class="sig sig-object py" id="ssmd.Document.__delitem__">
<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">__delitem__</span></span><span class="sig-paren">(</span><em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">index</span></span><span class="p"><span class="pre">:</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n"><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#int" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">int</span></a></span></em><span class="sig-paren">)</span> <span class="sig-return"><span class="sig-return-icon">&#x2192;</span> <span class="sig-return-typehint"><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/constants.html#None" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">None</span></a></span></span><a class="reference internal" href="../_modules/ssmd/document/#Document.__delitem__"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>
<dd><p>Delete sentence at index.</p>
<dl>
<dt>Args:</dt><dd><p>index: Sentence index</p>
</dd>
<dt>Raises:</dt><dd><p>IndexError: If index is out of range</p>
</dd>
<dt>Example:</dt><dd><div class="doctest highlight-default notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ssmd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Document</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;First. Second. Third.&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="k">del</span> <span class="n">doc</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]</span>  <span class="c1"># Remove second sentence</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</dd>
</dl>
</dd></dl>

<dl class="py method">
<dt class="sig sig-object py" id="ssmd.Document.__iadd__">
<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">__iadd__</span></span><span class="sig-paren">(</span><em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">other</span></span><span class="p"><span class="pre">:</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n"><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">str</span></a><span class="w"> </span><span class="p"><span class="pre">|</span></span><span class="w"> </span><a class="reference internal" href="#ssmd.document.Document" title="ssmd.document.Document"><span class="pre">Document</span></a></span></em><span class="sig-paren">)</span> <span class="sig-return"><span class="sig-return-icon">&#x2192;</span> <span class="sig-return-typehint"><a class="reference internal" href="#ssmd.document.Document" title="ssmd.document.Document"><span class="pre">Document</span></a></span></span><a class="reference internal" href="../_modules/ssmd/document/#Document.__iadd__"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>
<dd><p>Support += operator for appending content.</p>
<dl>
<dt>Args:</dt><dd><p>other: String or Document to append</p>
</dd>
<dt>Returns:</dt><dd><p>Self for chaining</p>
</dd>
<dt>Example:</dt><dd><div class="doctest highlight-default notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ssmd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Document</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;Hello&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span> <span class="o">+=</span> <span class="s2">&quot; world&quot;</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">other</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ssmd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Document</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;More&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span> <span class="o">+=</span> <span class="n">other</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</dd>
</dl>
</dd></dl>

<p><strong>Editing Methods:</strong></p>
<dl class="py method">
<dt class="sig sig-object py" id="ssmd.Document.insert">
<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">insert</span></span><span class="sig-paren">(</span><em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">index</span></span><span class="p"><span class="pre">:</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n"><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#int" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">int</span></a></span></em>, <em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">text</span></span><span class="p"><span class="pre">:</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n"><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">str</span></a></span></em>, <em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">separator</span></span><span class="p"><span class="pre">:</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n"><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">str</span></a></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o"><span class="pre">=</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="default_value"><span class="pre">''</span></span></em><span class="sig-paren">)</span> <span class="sig-return"><span class="sig-return-icon">&#x2192;</span> <span class="sig-return-typehint"><a class="reference internal" href="#ssmd.document.Document" title="ssmd.document.Document"><span class="pre">Document</span></a></span></span><a class="reference internal" href="../_modules/ssmd/document/#Document.insert"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>
<dd><p>Insert text at specific fragment index.</p>
<dl>
<dt>Args:</dt><dd><p>index: Position to insert (0 = beginning)
text: SSMD text to insert
separator: Separator to use (“”, “n”, or “nn”)</p>
</dd>
<dt>Returns:</dt><dd><p>Self for method chaining</p>
</dd>
<dt>Example:</dt><dd><div class="doctest highlight-default notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ssmd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Document</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;Hello world&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">insert</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">&quot;Start: &quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">&quot;&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">ssmd</span>
<span class="go">&#39;Start: Hello world&#39;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</dd>
</dl>
</dd></dl>

<dl class="py method">
<dt class="sig sig-object py" id="ssmd.Document.remove">
<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">remove</span></span><span class="sig-paren">(</span><em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">index</span></span><span class="p"><span class="pre">:</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n"><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#int" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">int</span></a></span></em><span class="sig-paren">)</span> <span class="sig-return"><span class="sig-return-icon">&#x2192;</span> <span class="sig-return-typehint"><a class="reference internal" href="#ssmd.document.Document" title="ssmd.document.Document"><span class="pre">Document</span></a></span></span><a class="reference internal" href="../_modules/ssmd/document/#Document.remove"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>
<dd><p>Remove fragment at index.</p>
<p>This is the same as <cite>del doc[index]</cite> but returns self for chaining.</p>
<dl>
<dt>Args:</dt><dd><p>index: Fragment index to remove</p>
</dd>
<dt>Returns:</dt><dd><p>Self for method chaining</p>
</dd>
<dt>Raises:</dt><dd><p>IndexError: If index is out of range</p>
</dd>
<dt>Example:</dt><dd><div class="doctest highlight-default notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ssmd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Document</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;First. Second. Third.&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">remove</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</dd>
</dl>
</dd></dl>

<dl class="py method">
<dt class="sig sig-object py" id="ssmd.Document.clear">
<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">clear</span></span><span class="sig-paren">(</span><span class="sig-paren">)</span> <span class="sig-return"><span class="sig-return-icon">&#x2192;</span> <span class="sig-return-typehint"><a class="reference internal" href="#ssmd.document.Document" title="ssmd.document.Document"><span class="pre">Document</span></a></span></span><a class="reference internal" href="../_modules/ssmd/document/#Document.clear"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>
<dd><p>Remove all content from the document.</p>
<dl>
<dt>Returns:</dt><dd><p>Self for method chaining</p>
</dd>
<dt>Example:</dt><dd><div class="doctest highlight-default notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ssmd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Document</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;Hello world&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">clear</span><span class="p">()</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">ssmd</span>
<span class="go">&#39;&#39;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</dd>
</dl>
</dd></dl>

<dl class="py method">
<dt class="sig sig-object py" id="ssmd.Document.replace">
<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">replace</span></span><span class="sig-paren">(</span><em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">old</span></span><span class="p"><span class="pre">:</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n"><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">str</span></a></span></em>, <em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">new</span></span><span class="p"><span class="pre">:</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n"><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">str</span></a></span></em>, <em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">count</span></span><span class="p"><span class="pre">:</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n"><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#int" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">int</span></a></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o"><span class="pre">=</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="default_value"><span class="pre">-1</span></span></em><span class="sig-paren">)</span> <span class="sig-return"><span class="sig-return-icon">&#x2192;</span> <span class="sig-return-typehint"><a class="reference internal" href="#ssmd.document.Document" title="ssmd.document.Document"><span class="pre">Document</span></a></span></span><a class="reference internal" href="../_modules/ssmd/document/#Document.replace"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>
<dd><p>Replace text across all fragments.</p>
<dl>
<dt>Args:</dt><dd><p>old: Text to find
new: Text to replace with
count: Maximum replacements (-1 = all)</p>
</dd>
<dt>Returns:</dt><dd><p>Self for method chaining</p>
</dd>
<dt>Example:</dt><dd><div class="doctest highlight-default notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ssmd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Document</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;Hello world. Hello again.&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">replace</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;Hello&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">&quot;Hi&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">ssmd</span>
<span class="go">&#39;Hi world. Hi again.&#39;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</dd>
</dl>
</dd></dl>

<p><strong>Advanced Methods:</strong></p>
<dl class="py method">
<dt class="sig sig-object py" id="ssmd.Document.merge">
<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">merge</span></span><span class="sig-paren">(</span><em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">other</span></span><span class="p"><span class="pre">:</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n"><a class="reference internal" href="#ssmd.document.Document" title="ssmd.document.Document"><span class="pre">Document</span></a></span></em>, <em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">separator</span></span><span class="p"><span class="pre">:</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n"><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">str</span></a></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o"><span class="pre">=</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="default_value"><span class="pre">'\n\n'</span></span></em><span class="sig-paren">)</span> <span class="sig-return"><span class="sig-return-icon">&#x2192;</span> <span class="sig-return-typehint"><a class="reference internal" href="#ssmd.document.Document" title="ssmd.document.Document"><span class="pre">Document</span></a></span></span><a class="reference internal" href="../_modules/ssmd/document/#Document.merge"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>
<dd><p>Merge another document into this one.</p>
<dl>
<dt>Args:</dt><dd><p>other: Document to merge
separator: Separator to use between documents</p>
</dd>
<dt>Returns:</dt><dd><p>Self for method chaining</p>
</dd>
<dt>Example:</dt><dd><div class="doctest highlight-default notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc1</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ssmd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Document</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;First document.&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc2</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ssmd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Document</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;Second document.&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc1</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">merge</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">doc2</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc1</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">ssmd</span>
<span class="go">&#39;First document.\n\nSecond document.&#39;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</dd>
</dl>
</dd></dl>

<dl class="py method">
<dt class="sig sig-object py" id="ssmd.Document.split">
<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">split</span></span><span class="sig-paren">(</span><span class="sig-paren">)</span> <span class="sig-return"><span class="sig-return-icon">&#x2192;</span> <span class="sig-return-typehint"><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#list" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">list</span></a><span class="p"><span class="pre">[</span></span><a class="reference internal" href="#ssmd.document.Document" title="ssmd.document.Document"><span class="pre">Document</span></a><span class="p"><span class="pre">]</span></span></span></span><a class="reference internal" href="../_modules/ssmd/document/#Document.split"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>
<dd><p>Split document into individual sentence Documents.</p>
<dl>
<dt>Returns:</dt><dd><p>List of Document objects, one per sentence</p>
</dd>
<dt>Example:</dt><dd><div class="doctest highlight-default notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ssmd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Document</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;First. Second. Third.&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">sentences</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">doc</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">split</span><span class="p">()</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">sentences</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="go">3</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">sentences</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">ssmd</span>
<span class="go">&#39;First.&#39;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</dd>
</dl>
</dd></dl>

<dl class="py method">
<dt class="sig sig-object py" id="ssmd.Document.get_fragment">
<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">get_fragment</span></span><span class="sig-paren">(</span><em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">index</span></span><span class="p"><span class="pre">:</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n"><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#int" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">int</span></a></span></em><span class="sig-paren">)</span> <span class="sig-return"><span class="sig-return-icon">&#x2192;</span> <span class="sig-return-typehint"><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">str</span></a></span></span><a class="reference internal" href="../_modules/ssmd/document/#Document.get_fragment"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>
<dd><p>Get raw fragment by index (not sentence).</p>
<p>This accesses the internal fragment storage directly,
which may be different from sentence boundaries.</p>
<dl>
<dt>Args:</dt><dd><p>index: Fragment index</p>
</dd>
<dt>Returns:</dt><dd><p>Raw SSMD fragment string</p>
</dd>
<dt>Raises:</dt><dd><p>IndexError: If index is out of range</p>
</dd>
<dt>Example:</dt><dd><div class="doctest highlight-default notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ssmd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Document</span><span class="p">()</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">add</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;First&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">add_sentence</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;Second&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get_fragment</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="go">&#39;First&#39;</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get_fragment</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="go">&#39;Second&#39;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</dd>
</dl>
</dd></dl>

<dl class="py method">
<dt class="sig sig-object py" id="id0">
<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">__init__</span></span><span class="sig-paren">(</span><em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">content</span></span><span class="pre">None</span></a></span></span><a class="reference internal" href="../_modules/ssmd/document/#Document.__init__"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>
<dd><p>Initialize a new SSMD document.</p>
<dl>
<dt>Args:</dt><dd><p>content: Optional initial SSMD content
config: Configuration dictionary with options:</p>
<blockquote>
<div><ul class="simple">
<li><p>skip (list): Processor names to skip</p></li>
<li><p>output_speak_tag (bool): Wrap in &lt;speak&gt; tags (default: True)</p></li>
<li><p>pretty_print (bool): Format XML output (default: False)</p></li>
<li><p>auto_sentence_tags (bool): Auto-wrap sentences (default: False)</p></li>
<li><p>heading_levels (dict): Custom heading configurations</p></li>
<li><p>extensions (dict): Registered extension handlers</p></li>
<li><p>namespaces (dict): XML namespaces to add to the &lt;speak&gt; tag</p></li>
<li><p>sentence_model_size (str): spaCy model size for sentence
detection (“sm”, “md”, “lg”, “trf”). Default: “sm”</p></li>
<li><p>sentence_spacy_model (str): Deprecated alias; model size is
inferred from the name (overrides sentence_model_size)</p></li>
<li><p>sentence_use_spacy (bool): If False, use fast regex splitting
instead of spaCy. Default: True</p></li>
</ul>
</div></blockquote>
<dl class="simple">
<dt>capabilities: TTS capabilities (TTSCapabilities instance or</dt><dd><p>preset name). Presets: ‘espeak’, ‘pyttsx3’, ‘google’,
‘polly’, ‘azure’, ‘minimal’, ‘full’</p>
</dd>
<dt>escape_syntax: If True, escape SSMD-like syntax in content to</dt><dd><p>prevent interpretation as markup. Useful for plain text or
markdown that may coincidentally contain SSMD patterns.</p>
</dd>
<dt>escape_patterns: List of specific pattern types to escape when</dt><dd><p>escape_syntax=True. If None, escapes all patterns.
Valid values: ‘emphasis’, ‘annotations’, ‘breaks’, ‘marks’,
‘headings’, ‘directives’</p>
</dd>
<dt>parse_yaml_header: If True, parse YAML front matter and store it</dt><dd><p>on doc.header while stripping it from the SSMD body. If False,
YAML front matter is preserved as part of the content.</p>
</dd>
<dt>strict: If True, emit warnings and apply ssml-green validation</dt><dd><p>rules where possible.</p>
</dd>
</dl>
</dd>
<dt>Example:</dt><dd><div class="doctest highlight-default notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ssmd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Document</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;Hello *world*!&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ssmd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Document</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">capabilities</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s1">&#39;pyttsx3&#39;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ssmd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Document</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;Text&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">config</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="s1">&#39;auto_sentence_tags&#39;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">})</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="c1"># Fast sentence detection (no spaCy required)</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ssmd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Document</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">config</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="s1">&#39;sentence_use_spacy&#39;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="kc">False</span><span class="p">})</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="c1"># High quality sentence detection</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ssmd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Document</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">config</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="s1">&#39;sentence_model_size&#39;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s1">&#39;lg&#39;</span><span class="p">})</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="c1"># Escape SSMD syntax for plain text/markdown</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ssmd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Document</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">markdown</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">escape_syntax</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="c1"># Selective escaping</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ssmd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Document</span><span class="p">(</span>
<span class="gp">... </span>    <span class="n">text</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="gp">... </span>    <span class="n">escape_syntax</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="gp">... </span>    <span class="n">escape_patterns</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">&#39;emphasis&#39;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">&#39;annotations&#39;</span><span class="p">]</span>
<span class="gp">... </span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</dd>
</dl>
</dd></dl>

<dd><p>Create a Document from SSML string.</p>
<dl>

config: Optional configuration parameters
capabilities: Optional TTS capabilities</p>
</dd>
<dt>Returns:</dt><dd><p>New Document instance with converted content</p>
</dd>
<dt>Example:</dt><dd><div class="doctest highlight-default notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">ssml</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s1">&#39;&lt;speak&gt;&lt;emphasis&gt;Hello&lt;/emphasis&gt; world&lt;/speak&gt;&#39;</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ssmd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Document</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">from_ssml</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">ssml</span><span class="p">)</span>

config: Optional configuration parameters

<dl class="py method">
<dt class="sig sig-object py" id="id3">
<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">add</span></span><span class="sig-paren">(</span><em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">text</span></span><span class="p"><span class="pre">:</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n"><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">str</span></a></span></em><span class="sig-paren">)</span> <span class="sig-return"><span class="sig-return-icon">&#x2192;</span> <span class="sig-return-typehint"><a class="reference internal" href="#ssmd.document.Document" title="ssmd.document.Document"><span class="pre">Document</span></a></span></span><a class="reference internal" href="../_modules/ssmd/document/#Document.add"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>
<dd><p>Append text without separator.</p>
<p>Use this when you want to append content immediately after
the previous content with no spacing.</p>
<dl>
<dt>Args:</dt><dd><p>text: SSMD text to append</p>
</dd>
<dt>Returns:</dt><dd><p>Self for method chaining</p>
</dd>
<dt>Example:</dt><dd><div class="doctest highlight-default notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ssmd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Document</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;Hello&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">add</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot; world&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">ssmd</span>
<span class="go">&#39;Hello world&#39;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</dd>
</dl>
</dd></dl>

<dl class="py method">
<dt class="sig sig-object py" id="id4">
<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">add_sentence</span></span><span class="sig-paren">(</span><em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">text</span></span><span class="p"><span class="pre">:</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n"><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">str</span></a></span></em><span class="sig-paren">)</span> <span class="sig-return"><span class="sig-return-icon">&#x2192;</span> <span class="sig-return-typehint"><a class="reference internal" href="#ssmd.document.Document" title="ssmd.document.Document"><span class="pre">Document</span></a></span></span><a class="reference internal" href="../_modules/ssmd/document/#Document.add_sentence"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>
<dd><p>Append text with newline separator.</p>
<p>Use this to add a new sentence on a new line.</p>
<dl>
<dt>Args:</dt><dd><p>text: SSMD text to append</p>
</dd>
<dt>Returns:</dt><dd><p>Self for method chaining</p>
</dd>
<dt>Example:</dt><dd><div class="doctest highlight-default notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ssmd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Document</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;First sentence.&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">add_sentence</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;Second sentence.&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">ssmd</span>
<span class="go">&#39;First sentence.\nSecond sentence.&#39;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</dd>
</dl>
</dd></dl>

<dl class="py method">
<dt class="sig sig-object py" id="id5">
<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">add_paragraph</span></span><span class="sig-paren">(</span><em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">text</span></span><span class="p"><span class="pre">:</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n"><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">str</span></a></span></em><span class="sig-paren">)</span> <span class="sig-return"><span class="sig-return-icon">&#x2192;</span> <span class="sig-return-typehint"><a class="reference internal" href="#ssmd.document.Document" title="ssmd.document.Document"><span class="pre">Document</span></a></span></span><a class="reference internal" href="../_modules/ssmd/document/#Document.add_paragraph"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>

<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">add_paragraph</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;Second paragraph.&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>

</pre></div>
</div>
</dd>

<dd><p>Export document to SSML format.</p>

</dd>

</pre></div>
</div>
</dd>
</dl>
</dd></dl>

<dl class="py method">
<dt class="sig sig-object py" id="id7">
<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">to_ssmd</span></span><span class="sig-paren">(</span><span class="sig-paren">)</span> <span class="sig-return"><span class="sig-return-icon">&#x2192;</span> <span class="sig-return-typehint"><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">str</span></a></span></span><a class="reference internal" href="../_modules/ssmd/document/#Document.to_ssmd"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>

<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">to_ssmd</span><span class="p">()</span>

</pre></div>
</div>
</dd>
</dl>
</dd></dl>

<dl class="py method">

<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">to_text</span></span><span class="sig-paren">(</span><span class="sig-paren">)</span> <span class="sig-return"><span class="sig-return-icon">&#x2192;</span> <span class="sig-return-typehint"><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">str</span></a></span></span><a class="reference internal" href="../_modules/ssmd/document/#Document.to_text"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>

</pre></div>
</div>
</dd>

<dl class="py method">
<dt class="sig sig-object py" id="id12">
<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">sentences</span></span><span class="sig-paren">(</span><em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">as_documents</span></span><span class="p"><span class="pre">:</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n"><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#bool" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">bool</span></a></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o"><span class="pre">=</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="default_value"><span class="pre">False</span></span></em><span class="sig-paren">)</span> <span class="sig-return"><span class="sig-return-icon">&#x2192;</span> <span class="sig-return-typehint"><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/collections.abc.html#collections.abc.Iterator" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">Iterator</span></a><span class="p"><span class="pre">[</span></span><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">str</span></a><span class="w"> </span><span class="p"><span class="pre">|</span></span><span class="w"> </span><a class="reference internal" href="#ssmd.document.Document" title="ssmd.document.Document"><span class="pre">Document</span></a><span class="p"><span class="pre">]</span></span></span></span><a class="reference internal" href="../_modules/ssmd/document/#Document.sentences"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>
<dd><p>Iterate through sentence-level SSML chunks.</p>
<p>Sentences are always returned as explicit <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">&lt;s&gt;</span></code>-wrapped SSML fragments
so the streaming interface remains stable regardless of paragraph tags.</p>
<dl>
<dt>Args:</dt><dd><dl class="simple">
<dt>as_documents: If True, yield Document objects instead of strings.</dt><dd><p>Each sentence will be wrapped in its own Document instance.</p>
</dd>
</dl>
</dd>
<dt>Yields:</dt><dd><p>SSML sentence strings (str), or Document objects if as_documents=True</p>
</dd>
<dt>Example:</dt><dd><div class="doctest highlight-default notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="n">doc</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ssmd</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Document</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;First. Second. Third.&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">sentence</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">doc</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">sentences</span><span class="p">():</span>
<span class="gp">... </span>    <span class="n">tts_engine</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">speak</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">sentence</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<div class="doctest highlight-default notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="gp">&gt;&gt;&gt; </span><span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">sentence_doc</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">doc</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">sentences</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">as_documents</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">):</span>
<span class="gp">... </span>    <span class="n">ssml</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">sentence_doc</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">to_ssml</span><span class="p">()</span>
<span class="gp">... </span>    <span class="n">ssmd</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">sentence_doc</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">to_ssmd</span><span class="p">()</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</dd>
</dl>
</dd></dl>

<dl class="py method">
<dt class="sig sig-object py" id="ssmd.Document.paragraphs">
<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">paragraphs</span></span><span class="sig-paren">(</span><em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">as_documents</span></span><span class="p"><span class="pre">:</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n"><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#bool" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">bool</span></a></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o"><span class="pre">=</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="default_value"><span class="pre">False</span></span></em><span class="sig-paren">)</span> <span class="sig-return"><span class="sig-return-icon">&#x2192;</span> <span class="sig-return-typehint"><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/collections.abc.html#collections.abc.Iterator" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">Iterator</span></a><span class="p"><span class="pre">[</span></span><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">str</span></a><span class="w"> </span><span class="p"><span class="pre">|</span></span><span class="w"> </span><a class="reference internal" href="#ssmd.document.Document" title="ssmd.document.Document"><span class="pre">Document</span></a><span class="p"><span class="pre">]</span></span></span></span><a class="reference internal" href="../_modules/ssmd/document/#Document.paragraphs"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>
<dd><p>Iterate through paragraph-level SSML chunks.</p>
<p>Paragraphs are returned with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">&lt;p&gt;</span></code> tags when supported by capabilities.</p>
<dl class="simple">
<dt>Args:</dt><dd><p>as_documents: If True, yield Document objects instead of strings.</p>
</dd>
<dt>Yields:</dt><dd><p>SSML paragraph strings (str), or Document objects if as_documents=True</p>
</dd>
</dl>
</dd></dl>

<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">__len__</span></span><span class="sig-paren">(</span><span class="sig-paren">)</span> <span class="sig-return"><span class="sig-return-icon">&#x2192;</span> <span class="sig-return-typehint"><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#int" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">int</span></a></span></span><a class="reference internal" href="../_modules/ssmd/document/#Document.__len__"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>

Second sentence.&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>

<dl class="py method">
<dt class="sig sig-object py" id="id14">

<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">__getitem__</span></span><span class="sig-paren">(</span><em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">index</span></span><span class="p"><span class="pre">:</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n"><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#slice" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">slice</span></a></span></em><span class="sig-paren">)</span> <span class="sig-return"><span class="sig-return-icon">&#x2192;</span> <span class="sig-return-typehint"><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#list" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">list</span></a><span class="p"><span class="pre">[</span></span><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">str</span></a><span class="p"><span class="pre">]</span></span></span></span></dt>

Second. Third.&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>

Second. Third.&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>

</pre></div>

Second. Third.&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>

<dl class="py method">
<dt class="sig sig-object py" id="id17">

Second.&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>

<dl class="py method">
<dt class="sig sig-object py" id="id18">
<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">__iadd__</span></span><span class="sig-paren">(</span><em class="sig-param"><span class="n"><span class="pre">other</span></span><span class="p"><span class="pre">:</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n"><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#str" title="(in Python v3.14)"><span class="pre">str</span></a><span class="w"> </span><span class="p"><span class="pre">|</span></span><span class="w"> </span><a class="reference internal" href="#ssmd.document.Document" title="ssmd.document.Document"><span class="pre">Document</span></a></span></em><span class="sig-paren">)</span> <span class="sig-return"><span class="sig-return-icon">&#x2192;</span> <span class="sig-return-typehint"><a class="reference internal" href="#ssmd.document.Document" title="ssmd.document.Document"><span class="pre">Document</span></a></span></span><a class="reference internal" href="../_modules/ssmd/document/#Document.__iadd__"><span class="viewcode-link"><span class="pre">[source]</span></span></a></dt>
<dd><p>Support += operator for appending content.</p>
